title: A file leaves. Its place stays.
subtitle: Setup · archive · read · restore · verify · upgrade · import
steps: Verify marker and volume UUID. Resolve the project and its recorded target.
Recent writes, busy markers, open handles and database sidecars keep it local.
Hold the repo lock. Check SHA-256. Flush the durable record before removing the source.
Empty folders follow their archived files into _archive/. mkdir + rmdir never carry a file.

details: read prints a raw file’s archive location. For compressed data, read --head N streams a sample. Over 10 GB, full decompression requires --full.
restore checks size, hash, free space and metadata. It removes the record and archive copy, saves the indexes, then repairs the parked folder tree.
verify is read-only. Inspect its findings before verify --fix. Differing copies and unknown orphans remain for a person to inspect.
Every record carries format and writer version. .history/ freezes authentic released runtimes. Original releases were unavailable, so historical fallback is limited to releases actually present.
